description: Make a math cage puzzle (Latin square with arithmetic cages, 4x4 to 9x9) with exactly one solution. More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

answers.description: With format=svg: draw the solution (default false).

seed.description: Whole number 0–4294967295. The same seed and options always give the same puzzle; leave it out for a random one (the response tells you the seed it used).

svg.description: Include SVG images of the puzzle and its solution in the JSON (default true).

name: make_math_cages
title: Make a math cage puzzle
